title: Uplift Desk Position Log Failure Rate
dataSources: Pomodoro focus sessions (`pomofocus:session`), desk position logs (`upliftdesk:desk`), Elgato Key Light usage (`elgato:keylight`), calendar meetings (`calendar:event`), and Stretchly breaks (`stretchly:break`).
app: Pomofocus sessions, Uplift desk position logs, Elgato Key Light telemetry, Stretchly break reminders, and meeting calendar events sent to Splunk.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=upliftdesk:desk
| eval status_value=lower(coalesce(posture_status,"unknown"))
| eval failed=if(match(status_value,"error|fail|alert|overdue|late|stale|breach"),1,0)
| stats count as events, sum(failed) as failed_events by desk_profile
| eval failure_pct=round(100*failed_events/events,1)
| sort - failure_pct - failed_events
description: Measures how often Uplift desk position log records land in an unhealthy or exception state for each desk profile.
value: A plain failure-rate view highlights noisy devices, flaky automations, and habits that repeatedly slip.
implementation: Normalize posture_status values into good or bad states and review the failure percentage per desk profile.
visualization: Bar chart of failure percentage by entity.
grandmaExplanation: It highlights which parts of your Uplift desk position log data keep ending up in a bad state instead of working cleanly.
